profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Flutter • iOS • Android
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer with over 15 years of experience, and I’ve worked across several industries including finance, marketing, manufacturing, and health. I spent a good portion of my career building backend APIs and services with Microsoft technologies — .NET, SQL Server, Azure — but over the last 5 years, I’ve shifted my focus to mobile development in Flutter.
